prompt: What is the main purpose of a stub zone?
options: Help a resolver locate authoritative DNS servers for a namespace
Store every host record as a full backup
Assign addresses to guest operating systems
Create trust relationships between AD domains
en: A stub keeps limited authority information rather than all ordinary records.
ru: Stub limited authority information rakhta hai, tamam ordinary records nahin.

prompt: Which collection best describes stub-zone records?
options: SOA, NS and necessary address/glue records
All A, CNAME and PTR records in the full zone
Only MX records and TXT verification tokens
Only client subnet masks and routes
en: These records describe authority and how to reach it.
ru: Yeh records authority aur us tak pohanchne ki information dete hain.

prompt: Does a stub always contain exactly three individual records?
options: No; the relevant record categories can have multiple entries
Yes; one SOA, one NS and one A are the only possible entries
Yes; Windows deletes any fourth record automatically
No; it must contain every host record instead
en: Record categories are not the same as a fixed count of individual records.
ru: Record categories aur individual records ki fixed tadaad aik cheez nahin.

prompt: Which record type names an authoritative DNS server?
options: NS
PTR
MX
TXT
en: NS names the authoritative server; address information helps reach it.
ru: NS authoritative server ka naam batata hai; address information us tak pohanchati hai.

prompt: What is the purpose of necessary address/glue data in a stub?
options: Help locate the network addresses of its name servers
Guarantee that every host in the zone is replicated
Apply firewall policy to every client
Replace all reverse lookup zones
en: Name-server address data supports contacting authorities, not full host replication.
ru: Name-server address data authority se contact mein madad karta hai, full host replication nahin.

prompt: What is the stub’s configured master-server list used for?
options: Loading and refreshing its limited zone information
Selecting the client’s default gateway
Listing every guest VM on an ESXi switch
Storing private DNSSEC signing keys
en: The refresh source list and the NS authority list are related but distinct.
ru: Refresh source list aur NS authority list related magar alag hain.

prompt: Can a suitable secondary server supply stub-zone information?
options: Yes, a configured source may be a primary or secondary hosting the zone
No, only an AD domain controller can supply it
No, a source must itself be a stub
Yes, but only after all host records are deleted
en: A source hosting the zone can supply the required authority records.
ru: Zone host karne wala source required authority records de sakta hai.

prompt: Which statement distinguishes a secondary from a stub?
options: A secondary has full read-only zone data; a stub has limited authority information
Both always store every ordinary record
A stub is writable while a secondary stores only NS records
Neither can participate in name resolution
en: They solve different needs: full replicated answers versus authority discovery.
ru: Dono ki needs alag: full replicated answers aur authority discovery.

prompt: Is a server permanently restricted to being a stub server for every zone?
options: No; zone roles are specific to each hosted zone
Yes; the role is fixed to the physical motherboard
Yes; changing another zone’s role requires replacing Windows
No; every stub is automatically a primary too
en: One machine can host different roles for different namespaces.
ru: Aik machine mukhtalif namespaces ke liye mukhtalif roles rakh sakti hai.

prompt: Which statement about stub performance is accurate?
options: It can aid authority discovery but does not guarantee every query is faster
Every stub query is guaranteed faster than a primary query
Stub configuration doubles the physical link speed
A stub always removes all network dependencies
en: Resolution depends on connectivity, caching and reachable authorities, not the label alone.
ru: Resolution connectivity, cache aur reachable authorities par depend karti hai, sirf label par nahin.

prompt: Which machine hosts the stub/resolving role in the classroom example?
options: The subnet mask — 255.255.255.0
en: DNS03 is the recorded stub/resolver; DNS01 is primary and DNS02 secondary.
ru: Recorded stub/resolver DNS03 hai; DNS01 primary aur DNS02 secondary hai.

prompt: Which zone name should be used to create the classroom forward stub?
options: VCPLAB.Com
DNS03 only
The VMware library folder name
en: The stub identifies the namespace whose authorities are to be discovered.
ru: Stub us namespace ko identify karta hai jis ki authorities dhoondni hain.

prompt: Which master address was used for DNS03’s classroom stub setup?
en: DNS01 .121 supplied the recorded stub’s zone information.
ru: Recorded stub ki information DNS01 .121 se li gayi.

prompt: The forward stub shows SOA, NS for DNS01 and a necessary DNS01 A record, but no DNS02 A or DNS alias. What is the best interpretation?
options: That limited set is consistent with a stub, not a full copy
The stub must be corrupt because every host must appear
DNS02 has been removed from the entire DNS namespace
The alias must be replaced with a default route
en: Absence of ordinary host/alias records is expected in the stub’s limited data.
ru: Stub ke limited data mein ordinary host/alias records ka na hona expected hai.

prompt: Which command directly tests resolution through DNS03 for DNS02’s name?
options: nslookup dns02.vcplab.com. 192.168.0.123
nslookup dns03.vcplab.com. 192.168.0.121
nslookup dns02.vcplab.com. 192.168.0.122
nslookup dns01.vcplab.com. 192.168.0.121
en: The final argument chooses DNS03 as the answering resolver.
ru: Aakhri argument answering resolver DNS03 choose karta hai.

prompt: DNS03 returns the correct .122 address for DNS02. What does that prove?
options: The lookup succeeded through DNS03 at that time
DNS03 holds all host records as a full secondary
The exact upstream packet path has been captured
Every authority can now be powered off safely
en: A correct result does not reveal the entire storage model or exclude caching.
ru: Correct result poora storage model ya cache ka na hona prove nahin karta.

prompt: DNS03 returns Non-authoritative answer for a name resolved through its stub setup. What is a reasonable interpretation?
options: A recursive or cached answer can be correct without DNS03 holding the full authoritative data
The response must contain a wrong IP
The stub has necessarily become a writable primary
The query automatically validated every DNSSEC signature
en: Non-authoritative is not an error verdict or evidence of full-copy storage.
ru: Non-authoritative error verdict ya full-copy storage ka proof nahin.

prompt: Which reverse stub matches the classroom 192.168.0.0/24 network?
options: 0.168.192.in-addr.arpa
192.168.0.in-addr.arpa
123.168.192.in-addr.arpa
VCPLAB.Com.ipv4
en: The reverse namespace is separate and reverses the /24 network octets.
ru: Reverse namespace alag hai aur /24 network octets ulat kar banti hai.

prompt: DNS03’s reverse stub shows authority information without the full PTR list. What is expected?
options: The resolver can obtain reverse answers from a reachable authority or usable cache
The reverse stub must contain all PTRs before any lookup can work
A forward CNAME must replace every PTR
The server’s gateway must equal the queried host address
en: A stub does not need to store every PTR to help resolve reverse names.
ru: Reverse names resolve karne mein madad ke liye stub ko har PTR store karna zaroori nahin.

prompt: A team wants an additional server to answer all existing zone records independently from a valid full copy. Which role fits that requirement?
options: A secondary zone
A stub zone alone
A conditional-forwarder rule alone
A client suffix setting alone
en: A secondary is the full-copy option; a stub is not an equivalent redundancy copy.
ru: Full-copy option secondary hai; stub us jaisi redundancy copy nahin.

prompt: DNS03 cannot load its stub information. Which checks are most relevant?
options: Correct zone/master, network access, DNS service and relevant source permissions
Only the client desktop theme
Only the ESXi datastore label
Only whether a public website has an MX record
en: The stub must reach a valid configured source and obtain the required data.
ru: Stub ko valid configured source tak pohanch kar required data leni hoti hai.

prompt: The stub contains DNS01 authority information, but DNS01 is unreachable. No usable answer is cached. What is a valid concern?
options: Resolution may fail if no listed usable authority is reachable
DNS02 is guaranteed to be used merely because it exists
The stub automatically becomes a full secondary
Every query returns DNS03’s own IP instead
en: A secondary’s existence alone does not establish its discovery or reachability through this stub.
ru: Sirf secondary ka maujood hona is stub se uski discovery ya reachability prove nahin karta.

prompt: What is a focused comparison when DNS03 cannot resolve a known classroom name?
options: Query that same full name directly against DNS01 and inspect DNS03’s authority/recursion path
Rename every server before running any query
Delete the reverse zone even though the issue is forward-only
Disable all network interfaces immediately
en: Direct source comparison helps separate source data problems from resolver/path issues.
ru: Source ko direct query karna data aur resolver/path issues alag karne mein madad karta hai.

prompt: An NS name remains in the stub but its address data points to an obsolete IP. What is the likely area to inspect?
options: The authority’s address data and stub refresh/source state
The client keyboard layout
The zone’s display capitalization alone
The Windows screen resolution
en: Authority names need usable address information to reach the correct server.
ru: Authority names ke saath correct server tak pohanchne ke liye usable address information chahiye.

prompt: Two queries through DNS03 succeed while DNS01 is running. Which claim is still unverified?
options: Resolution behavior when the required authorities become unavailable
That those two specific queries returned answers
That DNS03 was selected as query destination
That the requested names were submitted to the resolver
en: Normal successful queries are not a controlled authority-outage test.
ru: Normal successful queries controlled authority-outage test nahin hain.
